name: CENNETIC HMC450 Horizontal Machining Center
summary: The HMC450 is a horizontal machining center for multi-face box-type parts, using a rotary table to machine four sides plus top in fewer setups.

This Horizontal Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
